title: Geometry - Lesson 2 Practice: Cubic Centimeters and Liters
description: Practice converting between cubic centimeters and liters.

questions.question: How many cubic centimeters are equal to 1 liter?
questions.explanation: The key conversion is 1 L = 1000 cm³.

questions.question: Convert 4 L to cubic centimeters. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: Liters to cubic centimeters means multiply by 1000: 4 × 1000 = 4000.

questions.question: Convert 3000 cm³ to liters. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: Cubic centimeters to liters means divide by 1000: 3000 ÷ 1000 = 3.

questions.question: To convert liters to cubic centimeters, multiply by 1000.
questions.explanation: Cubic centimeters are smaller units, so the number increases when converting from liters to cm³.

questions.question: Explain why 1 L equals 1000 cm³.
questions.correctAnswer: A 10 cm by 10 cm by 10 cm cube has volume 1000 cm³, and that amount is equal to 1 liter.
questions.explanation: The conversion comes from three dimensions: 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000.

questions.question: Convert 0.75 L to cubic centimeters. Enter just the number.
A container has volume 6000 cm³. How many liters does it hold, and what operation did you use?
questions.explanation: Convert cm³ to L by dividing by 1000: 6000 ÷ 1000 = 6 L.
